Father (Okary Lendeborg): Played for the Dominican Republic national basketball team. He noted that while he worked, Yaxel spent much of his time with his mother, who became a major role model. Family Background: The family is of Dominican descent, with roots in Puerto Rico before moving to Ohio and later Pennsauken Township, New Jersey. Support System: Yissel is known for being a dedicated supporter, frequently attending Yaxel's games even while undergoing chemotherapy.
